verdict.rationale: fido2-manage is an open-source libfido2-based utility with command-line tools plus an optional GUI. The CLI covers passkey list/delete/edit, PIN management, bio enrollment, SSH keys and JSON/CSV export, so FIDO2 management is scriptable. Separately, Entra ID enrollment can be automated through the Graph API with PowerShell. However, no web/REST API was found (OpenAPI probes return 404), and nothing shows the all-in-one Companion App's PIV and OTP functions are exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented API or CLI equivalent for the Companion App's PIV/OTP/reset features, an explicit statement of UI-to-API parity, and independent corroboration.
